about.introP1: RM Design Studio is an interior design and architecture studio based in Haifa, specializing in office design, residential and commercial projects. The studio offers smart, innovative solutions — a blend of interior design, graphics, product design and advanced technology that connects everything.
about.introP2: We believe intelligent design is a result of research, dialogue with clients and stakeholders, and team effort. From parametric design and BIM to VR tools — we develop ideas into unforgettable spaces.
about.introP3: For us, every project is an exciting challenge, and every client is a world of dreams and needs. We bring our knowledge alongside design models from around the world, turning desires and dreams into tangible reality.

competition.title: Zakriyat Al-Nasrah
competition.subtitle: A cultural community center preserving generational memory in Nazareth
competition.highlight1: The Zakriyat Al-Nasrah project won 2nd place in the
competition.highlight2: Inspireli Awards 2021 — Public & Community Design category.
competition.body: "Zakriyat Al-Nasrah" is a cultural community center preserving generational memory in Nazareth. The Arabic name means "cultural memory", inspired by Christian-Arab tradition through traditional food and historic objects. Located in "Bayt Fawzi Azar" in Nazareth's Old Market — once a vital trade hub — the project aims to revive the market by linking heritage with the next generation, preserving Ottoman-era design alongside a modern intervention. The center offers theaters, a gallery and culture-themed cafés.
